subject: Post-demo: FinExt decision roadmap, security gates, and internal evangelist kit
body:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <pri.rao@finext.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + ask: decision timeline, security artifacts, and an evangelist kit

Hi team,

Great demo earlier — summary + immediate asks below so we can move FinExt to a decision milestone this quarter. I captured action owners and due dates next to each item.

Quick summary from call (Priya, Jake, and security attending):
- FinExt likes latency/cost profile; champion (Priya) sees value for automating loan-screener summaries.
- Primary blocking areas: procurement T&Cs timeline, security evidence for data retention and network separation, and finance sign-off on unit economics.
- Economic buyer is split between Priya (product lead) and Jake (head of platform) — both want a short ROI package.

Immediate asks and owners:
1) Security evidence index (deliverable: spreadsheet of artifacts + SOC2 scope) — owner: Neha — due: Fri 9/10
2) ROI one-pager (deliverable: customer-facing cost/benefit bullets + simple TCO math) — owner: Ben — due: Thu 9/9 COB
3) Mutual action plan (MAP) with procurement milestones for legal — owner: Mateo (I'll own consolidation) — due: Mon 9/13
4) Internal evangelist kit for Priya (talk tracks, objection handling, short email template to sponsor) — owner: Laura + Ben — due: Thu 9/9 morning

Attachments I will upload to our shared Drive and send to Priya directly: RI-ROI-one-pager.pdf (draft), FinExt-MAP-v1.docx, FinExt-security-evidence-index.xlsx.

Ask: Ben/Laura, can you craft a 2-paragraph elevator email Priya can forward to Jake and the CFO? Put the high-level dollar impact first and the security commitments second.

I'm going to align on procurement milestones with Jake; please flag any additional blockers in the next 24 hours.

Thanks,
Mateo

--
Mateo Alvarez
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Priya Rao <pri.rao@finext.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Morris <jmorris@finext.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 11:02:45 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: quick asks

Thanks for the demo, Mateo — good session. A few quick items from our side that would help us move internally:

- Can you send a clear one-pager we can show the CFO with ARR impact and run-rate savings? He doesn't need deep technical detail, just a direct $/FTE and time-to-value callout.
- Security wants a single spreadsheet that lists the artifacts you can provide and expected timelines (we don't need every doc now, just availability + owner).
- Procurement: we need a mutual action plan that shows legal review window and signing milestones.

If you can get the ROI one-pager + security index to me by end of week that'll let me start the sponsor sync with Jake and Legal.

Best,
Priya
Product Lead, FinExt

---
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <pri.rao@finext.com>, Jake Morris <jmorris@finext.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 08:22:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + artifacts (attachments)

Thanks Priya — attaching the draft pack in this reply. Quick notes below each attachment.

Attachments attached:
- RI-ROI-one-pager.pdf (attached, draft): includes conservative ARR uplift scenarios, headcount replacement estimates, and a 3-yr TCO table. Ben: please review A/B figures on pg2 and mark final.
- FinExt-security-evidence-index.xlsx (attached): table that maps our artifacts to common procurement asks (SOC2, data retention policy, network diagrams, customer keys). Neha: fill expected delivery dates and any redlines.
- FinExt-MAP-v1.docx (attached): MAP with proposed dates for procurement/legal, pilot window, and commercial sign-off. I'll propose the dates to Jake today.

Forwarding to Priya now.

Regards,
Mateo

[Attachment stubs: RI-ROI-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), FinExt-security-evidence-index.xlsx (Excel, 120KB), FinExt-MAP-v1.docx (Word, 45KB)]

-----Original Message-----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 10:16:50 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + ask: decision timeline, security artifacts, and internal evangelist kit

On Thu, Sep 9, 2027 at 08:22 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Priya — attaching the draft pack in this reply. Quick notes below each attachment.

Team — I took Mateo's ROI draft and tightened the CFO-facing bullets. Draft elevator email for Priya below (two short paragraphs as requested):

--- draft email for Priya to forward ---
Subject: Redwood Inference pilot proposal — $800k run-rate reduction in 12 months

Priya, Jake — following our demo, Redwood quantified a conservative $800k run-rate reduction in automated underwriting labor and a 6–8 week time-to-value for a pilot. The attached one-pager summarizes assumptions and the top-line ROI.

Redwood supports SOC2-aligned controls, customer key management, and a documented evidence index that legal can use for review. Neha will be our security contact for any detailed evidence requests.

--- end draft ---

Two asks for Laura: 1) add 2 quick objection responses for legal (data residency & retention), and 2) draft a 2-line Slack message Priya can drop to Jake after their sponsor call.

Ben
Seller, Redwood Inference

[No attachments in this message]

-----Original Message-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Thanks — attached are the two objection responses and the 2-line Slack note. I've also created a short internal "evangelist kit" folder in our Drive (link below) with:
- One-slide talk track (30s)
- 3 objection responses (legal/security)
- Slide with 3 customer stories and high-level metrics
- Email template for champion to send to execs

I'll push final versions to the Drive and ping Priya once Ben finalizes the numbers.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FinExtSharedAssets

Laura
Director, Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
